$janet.$comment: Not JSON Schema. Read by scripts/Test-OutputContracts.ps1, which is the point of the file living here rather than being generated from the return type.
$janet.$comment.contractField: The envelope stamps 'contract' and the gate cross-checks it against the number above, so code and schema cannot drift apart in either direction.
$janet.$comment.metadataValues: No field carries a blob's metadata value or an entity's content; only counts, the item that failed and the service's error.
$janet.$comment.everyKey: Every key is always present; a value that does not apply is null rather than absent.

contract.description: Bumped only by a format change. An engine change that moves this number is a mistake in one direction; a format change that does not is a mistake in the other.

outcome.description: 'applied': a refresh ran to the end. 'cleared': a clear ran to the end. 'stale': the plan recomputed now hashes differently from the planHash passed, so nothing was written. 'blocked': the plan has blockers, so nothing was written. 'failed': a write was refused or unreachable and the run stopped there; the counts show how far it got.

planHash.description: The plan hash recomputed now. It equals the one passed except when outcome is 'stale', where it is the current one to plan against.

deleted.description: What was deleted from the target so far. Zero for 'stale' and 'blocked'.

blobs.description: Target blobs deleted. A blob already gone counts as deleted.

copied.description: What was written to the target so far. Zero for 'cleared', 'stale' and 'blocked'.

entities.description: Entities upserted under the target client.

failure.description: Null unless outcome is 'failed': the first operation that did not succeed. Nothing after it was attempted.

copiedAt.description: UTC time (ISO 8601, round-trip format) the copy phase began, i.e. when staging started to hold the source's data. Null when it never began: clear, stale, blocked, or a failure during the deletes of a refresh that had something to copy.

clear.description: The exact storage_copy_apply call, mode clear, that removes what a refresh wrote; take storage_copy_plan with mode clear first for its planHash. Null in clear mode AND for 'stale' and 'blocked' outcomes: in those nothing was written, so there is nothing to clear.

item.description: What was being operated on: 'container/blobName' for a blob, 'table/partitionKey/rowKey' for an entity.

error.description: Why it failed. The code is the service's own error code (or 'HTTP nnn' when it gave none), 'unreachable' when no HTTP answer came back at all, or 'token' when a fresh Entra token could not be obtained mid-run.

code.description: The service's error code; 'HTTP nnn' when the service gave none, 'unreachable' or 'token' for a failure before or outside an HTTP answer.

message.description: The service's message, verbatim; for 'unreachable' and 'token', the failure's own message.

target.description: What the error is about, when the service said. Null when it did not.

details.description: The nested errors, in the same shape, as deep as the service sent them.
